_comment: Career tiers. Objectives must all be met to be promoted to the next tier. Kinds: jobs (distinct briefs finished with at least minStars, counting earlier tiers), flow (best flow score on a building type).

tiers.name: Local firm
tiers.unlocks: Restaurants (dining areas, commercial kitchens, booths), bigger family homes, terrazzo and rubber floors.

tiers.name: Regional
tiers.unlocks: Nightclubs (bars, dance floors, DJ booths), full-size restaurants and grocery stores, marble, slate and acoustic panels.

tiers.name: Established
tiers.unlocks: Apartment buildings (lobbies, mailboxes, package lockers) and estate homes with home theaters, gyms, king beds and wine walls.

objectives.text: Score 75+ flow on an apartment building

tiers.name: Elite
tiers.unlocks: Mansions, luxury residences and supper clubs: indoor pools, hot tubs, chandeliers, marble statues, grand pianos and copper roofs.
